name_en: Bachi jiru — soup made from the trimmed ends of hand-stretched somen
summary_ja: 浅口市鴨方町で、手延べそうめんをつくる際に端に出る「ばち」を大根や人参と煮た汁物。三味線の撥に形が似ることが名の由来とされ、そうめんよりコシが強く小さな子どもにも食べやすいという。
summary_en: The offcut ends of hand-stretched somen, called bachi for their resemblance to a shamisen pick, are simmered with daikon, carrot, and fried tofu in Asakuchi's Kamogata — said to hold a firmer bite than the somen strands themselves.
source_title: 手延べ素麺のばち汁 岡山県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
